fieldData.excerpt: We are pleased to announce that Radix has partnered with the world’s premier technology conference, Web Summit 2021, to bring Radix to the masses.
fieldData.main-content:
We are pleased to announce that Radix has partnered with the world’s premier technology conference, Web Summit 2021, to bring Radix to the masses. (And give away a Lamborghini, more on that later.)

Web Summit is gathering the founders and CEOs of the most advanced technology companies, fast-growing startups, policymakers, and heads of state in one place. Radix DLT will be represented by the core team to showcase its unparalleled technology on the Radix booth.

This event will be the kickoff for the marketing campaign to promote the launch of our next roadmap release, Alexandria, and the debut of our asset-oriented programming language, Scrypto. Web Summit is a step towards significant media attention, as the event is attended by media professionals from around the globe. The events surrounding Web Summit also provide invaluable networking opportunities.

To ensure we are well represented at Web Summit we purchased an additional 20 tickets for the Radix community. We had some excellent responses to our free ticket promotion, unfortunately, we could not take everyone that applied. The winners have now been contacted by email, and we look forward to seeing everyone there.

‍
On a more social note, the Radix community will be hosting a meet-up in Lisbon on the evening of the 3rd of November. This will be a great opportunity to meet and mingle, and we have been told there will be an unveiling of a new community project. Radix team members will be attending and looking forward to meeting as many of you as possible, you can RSVP to the community-organized event here. 

Lastly, a crypto event wouldn’t be the same without a Lambo, so If you’re attending Web Summit make sure to stop by E154, Pavillion 1, and say hello! We are giving away three Lego Technic Lamborghini Sian.


To get the latest news about Radix make sure to sign up to our mailing list here. You can also get involved with the Radix community on both Telegram and Discord.
fieldData.name: Radix is an Official Web Summit 2021 Partner
